title: Free lead sample
criteria: One free researched example and five additional US/Canadian local SEO agency profiles, with published business contacts, existing reporting workflows and a tailored geographic-ranking comparison.

leads.business_need: The agency offers recurring SEO for local businesses, including Google Maps work and monthly reports showing work performed and ranking changes. Its published service tiers include keyword tracking, and its founding team spans three distinct local markets.
leads.contact_instructions: Published business email: hello@prolocalbuilder.com. Business phone: 408-908-9940. The SEO page names founders Kyle in Appleton, Cesar in San Jose and Zac in Las Vegas.
leads.geography: Wisconsin, San Francisco Bay Area and Las Vegas, United States
leads.why_it_fits: Compare one consenting client's priority keyword across a neighborhood grid, then place the resulting read-only branded report beside the agency's existing monthly report. The three service regions offer different city densities, so use an explicit location, grid spacing and scan date. The comparison should establish whether geographic detail and client access improve the current reporting workflow.
leads.opening_message: Your SEO plans already include local rankings and a monthly account of what changed. Would one client keyword mapped across its actual service area be useful to compare with that report—using the same locations and date, with a client-readable link?
leads.status_note: Official service and business-contact sources reviewed on 13 October 2026. A suggested product comparison is a research assessment, to be confirmed with the agency.
